summary: Fix Phase 2 pre-gate review findings in VM edit, delete, bundled media and the create wizard. Core: a UEFI-to-BIOS edit interrupted at its define step now finishes at the next recovery pass (VMEDIT-1); a stopped edit that renames and changes Secure Boot validates first, renames, then edits the variable store and defines (F1, R-2); an interrupted vm-delete resumes on redelivery, a new delete with the same disk choice settles it and a different disk choice is refused (DEL-1, R-1); wiped disks no longer block storage detach (DEL-3); the virtio-win seed targets the live default storage, runs off the worker and re-checks under the operations lock (F5, F6, F8, R-3). Controller: PUT /api/v1/vms/{id} answers 400 when an interface at an existing index has no MAC and interfaces are removed or changed (VMEDIT-3). UI: UEFI-to-BIOS acknowledgement (VMEDIT-2), per-payload delete request_id (DEL-5), driver disc only on capable hosts and cleared when leaving Windows (F2 UI half, F3). API impact: changed contract — updateVM gains a 400 validation refusal and vm-delete gains interrupted-delete recovery and refusal results; no field or operation was added.

guide.reason: Edit guide documents the UEFI-to-BIOS acknowledgement, combined rename and Secure Boot saves, automatic recovery of an interrupted firmware removal and the MAC field; delete guide replaces troubleshooting that described a recovery Core refused with the recovery that now works and the disk-choice refusal; create guide states when the driver disc is pre-selected and that the rebuilt-ISO seed is unverified.

api.reason: updateVM: new 400 'when removing, reordering or changing a network interface, give every existing interface its MAC address', after the replay check with nothing saved, so a corrected retry under a new request_id is safe; an existing interface's MAC change is documented as remove-and-add (VMEDIT-4). vm-delete: redelivery of an interrupted delete resumes undefine and wipe over journaled paths; a new delete settles or refuses it by delete_disks. vm-update: UEFI-to-BIOS recovery from stage defining. No Controller/Core version skew: older Core keeps its previous results. Controller does not yet validate drivers_media_id (F2 Controller half, open).

roadmap.reason: Bug fixes inside the existing VM foundation; no milestone status changes until the Phase 2 gate runs.

state.reason: Recovery reads and settles the existing managed journal entries on the host; the Controller keeps no new record.
state.record: Existing vm-update, vm-delete and iso-import entries in the managed journal under the agent state directory on the pool master; a fresh Controller adopts VMs, tombstones and media from Inventory.managed through the existing adoption path.

verification.method: Code lanes wrote failing regression tests first and ran them before and after each fix: go test -race ./internal/vmhost/ ./internal/agent/ ./internal/controller/, npm --prefix web run typecheck/test/build, and simulated-browser runs of tests/integration/vm_edit_browser.py and managed_vm_browser.py --simulated (captures in a session scratchpad, not docs/qa). The documentation lane reran go test ./internal/vmhost/ ./internal/agent/ ./internal/controller/ ./internal/protocol/ (ok), npm --prefix web run test (ok), python3 scripts/generate_api.py --check and python3 -m unittest tests.test_api_contract (ok). Not run: any real libvirt or disposable-host walkthrough of interrupted deletes, firmware removal recovery, combined rename and Secure Boot, or the bundled seed on a rebuilt ISO; F2's Controller validation of drivers_media_id is not implemented.
